known_limitations.text: PEM power calculation is still not fully tested. PEMs input power assumes 90% efficiency. AC input is based on 220V AC.
Fiber BOM calculation for OTDR may calculate double number of cables
RFL is still a beta release - will be fully released with R3.1
R9.1 configuration rules not fully tested yet.
RD66TM not fullly modeled - not available for link/cable modeling.
